query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `subscriptions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `agencyId` int,
  `stripeCustomerId` varchar(255),
  `stripeSubscriptionId` varchar(255),
  `plan` enum('starter','professional','enterprise') NOT NULL,
  `billingCycle` enum('monthly','yearly') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly',
  `status` enum('trialing','active','past_due','canceled','expired') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'trialing',
  `trialEndsAt` timestamp NULL,
  `currentPeriodStart` timestamp NULL,
  `currentPeriodEnd` timestamp NULL,
  `cancelAtPeriodEnd` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `conversationsUsed` int DEFAULT 0,
  `scrapesUsed` int DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `scrapedBusinesses` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `agencyId` int NOT NULL,
  `scrapeJobId` int,
  `businessName` varchar(300) NOT NULL,
  `businessType` varchar(100),
  `businessSize` enum('small','medium','large') DEFAULT 'medium',
  `ownerName` varchar(200),
  `phone` varchar(50),
  `email` varchar(320),
  `website` text,
  `address` text,
  `city` varchar(100),
  `state` varchar(100),
  `pincode` varchar(10),
  `latitude` varchar(20),
  `longitude` varchar(20),
  `rating` decimal(3,1),
  `reviewCount` int,
  `placeId` varchar(200),
  `source` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'google_maps',
  `isImported` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
